verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a speech-to-text API service (fast, live, and batch transcription), not an agent that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The truncated llms.txt mention of MCP points at Zoom's own documentation catalog, which would be server-side at most. Nothing in the pack shows Scribe consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
